title: Phonic's New Voice Model Tops Agentic AI Speech Benchmark
summary:
The Phonic-1 system earned a score of 87.1 on the Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech index, outperforming xAI’s Grok Voice 3.0 for its ability to handle agentic voice tasks. The model completed 79.9% of customer-service simulations with 0.61 seconds to first audio. Phonic says the model is the only one capable of executing tool lookups and bookings while a user is still talking, allowing the system to respond 1.1 seconds after a caller stopped in a demo, compared to 15.7 seconds for OpenAI’s GPT-Live.

The 10 person startup recently raised a $27.5M Series A led by First Round, with participation from Lux Capital, Felicis and Definition, bringing its total funding to $31.5M. Its speech technology is currently used to power AI job interviews for recruiting platform Ashby across 25 countries.

selectedTweets.text:
A 10-person startup Phonic has released Phonic-1, which it says is the only voice model that can run lookups and bookings while the caller is still mid-sentence.

> First on Artificial Analysis’s speech-to-speech index at 87.1, just 0.2 points above xAI’s Grok Voice 3.0, completing 79.9% of customer-service tasks with 0.61 seconds to first audio.

> Phonic-1 calls tools while the caller is still talking; in the demo it finished 5 lookups mid-speech and replied 1.1 seconds after the caller stopped, versus 15.7 seconds for OpenAI’s GPT-Live.

> Phonic reports 90.2 on Cekura’s call suite, beating a transcribe-think-speak cascade at 82.9% that outscores every ranked speech-to-speech model there, though Cekura’s public board lists Phonic v1 at 68.3%.

> They raised a $27.5M Series A led by First Round, taking total funding to $31.5M, and Phonic already powers Ashby’s AI job interviews in 25 countries.
